Coverage

Photographers and videographers across New South Wales

From capital-city weddings to regional celebrations and corporate functions, New South Wales keeps photographers and videographers busy year round. Reel The Moment brings them together so you can search by area and event type in one place.

Start with the market closest to your venue, then compare a few providers on style, coverage hours and inclusions before you request quotes.

Choosing a provider. Look for a portfolio in the style you love first, then check availability for your date and what each package includes.

Good to know

Common questions in New South Wales

Do providers cover all of New South Wales?
Many photographers and videographers travel across New South Wales, while others focus on a particular city or region. Each market page lists providers who service that area, and most will confirm travel to your exact venue when you enquire.
How far in advance should I book?
For weddings and peak-season events, popular photographers and videographers are often booked six to twelve months ahead. For smaller events a few weeks can be enough. The earlier you enquire, the more choice you have.
Do I need both a photographer and a videographer?
It comes down to how you want to remember the day. Photos give you timeless stills to print and hang, while video captures movement, sound and speeches. Many couples book both, and coordinated photo and video packages can make that simpler and more cost effective.
